scope: Independent, line-by-line re-verification of the published 2026-10-23T09:23:57Z snapshot: Hotspawn inventory and lobby reconciliation, pick coverage for every active fixture, the Glicko expectation behind every ratings-only pick, the observed prices behind the two sampled money lines, and the new observed-price chip added to the phone summary in this session.

checks.claim: The published snapshot covers every future CS2 card that the Hotspawn lobby rendered at review time, with no fixture invented and none dropped.
checks.method: Read play.hotspawn.com/lobby and play.hotspawn.com/cs2-pickems at 2026-10-23T09:42Z-09:47Z, enumerated all 30 Closing Soon + Upcoming cards (29 with a View Match permalink, 1 without), and compared their fixture IDs with the 30 active IDs rendered in the published build.
checks.result: Set-equal apart from the documented substitution below: the lobby's 29 permalinked IDs are exactly the build's 30 active IDs minus 1081606, and 1081606 is the first-party API row for the 30th card (JiJieHao vs Eternal Fire). The two fixtures that the earlier 06:58Z gap banner listed (1081149 FORZE Reload vs LFO 10, 1081872 NEXVOID vs Rare Atom) no longer appear in the scheduled feed read at 09:52Z, so they are no longer missing from coverage.

sources.detail: CS2-only lobby: 203 matches this week, All tiers (92) at 09:47Z. Tier counts fall as fixtures start, which is why the earlier 94/203 reading is not a contradiction.
First-party fixture array used by Hotspawn's own client. Fixture 1081606 = JiJieHao vs Eternal Fire, DraculaN Season 7, scheduled_start_time 1792760400000 = 2026-10-23T13:00:00Z.
Published snapshot generated 2026-10-23T09:23:57Z, inventory 92 / upcoming 30 / archived 62.

checks.claim: Every active fixture carries a directional pick; no row is blank and no default 50/50 is used.
checks.method: Counted the rendered glance rows in the published build and re-read the published complete-picks counts, then checked the coverage invariant in scripts/coverage_audit.py against the checked-in fixture.
checks.result: 30 active, 30 with a pick, 22 from an external line (16 market + 3 bookmaker + 3 consensus) and 8 from a research model, 0 unresolved. Every one of the 30 rows shows both teams' probabilities in the phone summary.

checks.claim: The Glicko expectation published for every ratings-only pick is reproducible from Valve's official standings.
checks.method: Read the official 2026-10-05 global standings file from Valve's repository (blob 2aa2805394fbc68f36a5752a5b16026f2ab2fed5, committed 2026-10-05T16:36:11Z, 77,872 bytes). Recomputed p = 1/(1+10^(g*delta/400)) with g = 0.972821 for the fixed rating deviation of 75 published in model/fit.js, using the exact rating rows the site cites.
checks.result: All six ratings-only rows reproduce the published number to 0.1 point: Phantom Academy 783 vs Banda Chuya 801 -> 47.5/52.5; Acend 1197 vs UNiTY 1167 -> 54.2/45.8; Metizport 1290 vs BAKS 1044 -> 79.9/20.1; Color 1249 vs ex-Zero Tenacity 1066 -> 73.6/26.4; Rooster 718 vs Abyssal 734 -> 47.8/52.2; HOTU 1437 vs The Huns 944 -> 94.1/5.9. The Huns row is the 944-point standing (position 122), selected by the documented four-of-five roster join, not the 701-point same-name row.

sources.detail: Official Valve global standings, 2026-10-05. Rows used: Phantom Academy 783 (rank 165), Banda Chuya 801 (rank 165 listing at 801 and a 2-player remnant at 402, correctly excluded), Acend 1197, UNiTY 1167, Metizport 1290, BAKS 1044, Color 1249, ex-Zero Tenacity 1066, Rooster 718, Abyssal 734, HOTU 1437, The Huns 944 (rank 122).
Valve's published fit example, cited by the site for the fixed RD of 75 and the 400-point logistic scale.
The HOTU vs The Huns card publishes both rating inputs (1437 and 944), the roster join and the model limitation.
